Then, about 30 minutes ago, I was watching a YouTube video and a new tab suddenly opened and shifted my browser focus. It informed me that ABP had updated itself. I didn't think much of it, closed the tab and continued watching my video. When it was over, I remembered that I was going to watch Channel Zero: Candle Cove tonight. I opened up my TvGuide link and noticed that several elements that I had manually hidden to declutter the page were visible. I opened up APB's Element Hider and, upon re-hiding the promoted content, noticed that ABP now does not remove those elements until you refresh the page. That's annoying, but I could live with it. I scrolled the page and saw that CZ:CC would not air again until Saturday. So, I opened up Alluc.ee to see if someone had yet uploaded a stream of the episode. That website had ads all over it.

Growing frustrated, I opened up ABP's Filter Settings menu and noticed that all of my custom element filters and custom adblocking filters had been erased; not only that, but I had been unsubscribed from every single filter subscription. I brought up the filter subscription menu and found out that the lists that I used to have weren't even being offered, (some privacy filter lists and some anti-Adblock lists.) I sighed and subscribed to Easylist and Easy-Privacy and then closed that.

I closed the browser out, waited 20 seconds and opened it back up, (as I do whenever one of my addons updates, once I am at a good stopping point in what I'm doing.) When my pages reloaded, they all reloaded with ads, including the elements that I'd just hidden. Very annoyed, I opened up Adblock Plus' filter preferences and saw that it had, yet again, unsubscribed me from all of my filter subscriptions and deleted all of my custom element filters. That was the last straw.

Fuck you, Adblock Plus; fuck the people that run that company and fuck the people that code their updates.
